rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the removal of the serialization logic from the refactored `drawio` module. The `DrawIOParser` will only be responsible for parsing the Draw.io XML, not for serializing the output to OWL Manchester syntax.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote:
**Relevant Code Snippets:** ```python def _infer_type(literal: str) -> str: # ...
def _serialise_facts( facts: dict[str, set[str]], infer_type_of_literals: bool = True, prefix: str | None = None) -> Generator[str, None, None]: # ...
def _serialise_block( individual_identifier: str, individual_label: str, types_and_facts: dict[str, set[str]], serialisation_config: SerialisationConfig) -> str: # ...
def _preamble(serialisation_config: SerialisationConfig) -> str: # ...
def serialise(blocks: Blocks, serialisation_config: SerialisationConfig) -> str: # ... ```
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Delete Serialization Functions:** - Delete the functions `_infer_type`, `_serialise_facts`, `_serialise_block`, `_preamble`, and `serialise` from the `gbad_core/drawio.py` module. 2. **Delete Related Functions:** - Delete the `individual_blocks` and `_add_individual_type` functions, as their logic will be incorporated into the `DrawIOParser`'s `parse` method. 3. **Confirm `DrawIOParser` Output:** - Ensure that the `DrawIOParser`'s `parse()` method returns a structured representation of the graph (a list or generator of `Individual` and `Arrow` objects), as this will be the input to the new `RMLGenerator`.
